package storetranslatefixture

import (
	"slices"

	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/ast"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/collections"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/core"
)

// The generic helpers (Z1): the Node versions for a Node type argument, core
// for anything else.

func firstName(nodes []*ast.Node) *ast.Node {
	return core.FirstNonNil(nodes, func(n *ast.Node) *ast.Node { return n.Name() })
}

func firstSymbol(nodes []*ast.Node) *ast.Symbol {
	return core.FirstNonNil(nodes, func(n *ast.Node) *ast.Symbol { return n.Symbol() })
}

func names(nodes []*ast.Node) []*ast.Node {
	return core.MapNonNil(nodes, func(n *ast.Node) *ast.Node { return n.Name() })
}

func kinds(symbols []*ast.Symbol) []*ast.Node {
	return core.MapNonNil(symbols, func(s *ast.Symbol) *ast.Node { return s.ValueDeclaration })
}

func symbolsOf(nodes []*ast.Node) []*ast.Symbol {
	return core.MapNonNil(nodes, func(n *ast.Node) *ast.Symbol { return n.Symbol() })
}

func nameOrNode(node *ast.Node) *ast.Node {
	return core.OrElse(node.Name(), node)
}

func exportOrLocal(local *ast.Symbol) *ast.Symbol {
	return core.OrElse(local.ExportSymbol, local)
}

func parents(nodes []*ast.Node) []*ast.Node {
	return core.SameMap(nodes, func(n *ast.Node) *ast.Node { return n.Parent })
}

func parentsIndex(nodes []*ast.Node) []*ast.Node {
	return core.SameMapIndex(nodes, func(n *ast.Node, i int) *ast.Node { return n.Parent })
}

func unique(nodes []*ast.Node) []*ast.Node {
	return core.Deduplicate(nodes)
}

func uniqueKinds(kinds []ast.Kind) []ast.Kind {
	return core.Deduplicate(kinds)
}

func addDeclaration(declarations []*ast.Node, node *ast.Node) []*ast.Node {
	return core.AppendIfUnique(declarations, node)
}

func hasNode(nodes []*ast.Node, node *ast.Node) bool {
	return slices.Contains(nodes, node) && slices.Index(nodes, node) >= 0
}

func hasKind(kinds []ast.Kind, kind ast.Kind) bool {
	return slices.Contains(kinds, kind)
}

// The composite keys (Z1): the node field of a key-only struct is a NodeKey,
// its constructions and assignments take Key(), a nil literal is NodeKey{}.

type Type struct{ id int }

type nonExistentPropertyKey struct {
	propNode       *ast.Node
	containingType *Type
	isUncheckedJS  bool
}

type accessibleChainCacheKey struct {
	useOnlyExternalAliasing bool
	location                *ast.Node
	meaning                 ast.SymbolFlags
}

type checker struct {
	nonExistentProperties collections.Set[nonExistentPropertyKey]
	accessibleChainCache  map[accessibleChainCacheKey][]*ast.Symbol
}

func (c *checker) reportNonExistentProperty(propNode *ast.Node, containingType *Type, isUncheckedJS bool) bool {
	key := nonExistentPropertyKey{propNode, containingType, isUncheckedJS}
	if c.nonExistentProperties.Has(key) {
		return false
	}
	c.nonExistentProperties.Add(key)
	keyed := nonExistentPropertyKey{propNode: nil, containingType: containingType}
	keyed.propNode = propNode
	return c.nonExistentProperties.Has(keyed)
}

func (c *checker) accessibleChain(useOnlyExternalAliasing bool, location *ast.Node, meaning ast.SymbolFlags) []*ast.Symbol {
	linkKey := accessibleChainCacheKey{useOnlyExternalAliasing, location, meaning}
	if c.accessibleChainCache == nil {
		c.accessibleChainCache = make(map[accessibleChainCacheKey][]*ast.Symbol)
	}
	if chain, ok := c.accessibleChainCache[linkKey]; ok {
		return chain
	}
	c.accessibleChainCache[accessibleChainCacheKey{meaning: meaning}] = nil
	return nil
}

// A map keyed by a node: map[store.NodeKey]T and Key() at every index.
func count(nodes []*ast.Node) map[*ast.Node]int {
	counts := map[*ast.Node]int{}
	for _, n := range nodes {
		counts[n]++
		delete(counts, n.Parent)
	}
	return counts
}

// The accessors, nil and the lists.
func argumentsOf(node *ast.Node) int {
	total := 0
	for i, arg := range node.Arguments() {
		if arg != nil && arg.Kind == ast.KindIdentifier && node.Parent != arg {
			total += i
		}
	}
	if len(node.AsCallExpression().Arguments.Nodes) > 0 && node.AsCallExpression().Arguments.Nodes[0].Pos() < node.End() {
		return total
	}
	return -1
}
